# Book Homes - UK holiday homes booked direct (Manchester, Prestwich, Liverpool; now taking hosts in London and Gateshead)

> Book Homes (bookhomes.co.uk) is a UK marketplace for whole-home short stays booked direct with the host, with no guest booking fees. Homes are live now in Manchester (including Prestwich, Crumpsall and Salford) and Liverpool. It is now taking hosts in London (Golders Green and Stamford Hill) and Gateshead. Some homes are kosher-friendly: the host declares a kosher kitchen or a Shabbat-friendly set-up (not a certification). The "Areas" section below says which areas have live homes and which are now taking hosts. Area pages: https://bookhomes.co.uk/stays-in

## Zermatt Lodge, Liverpool

Zermatt Lodge, listed on Book Homes, is an entire 4-bedroom, 2-bathroom house to rent in Liverpool, UK, for short stays by groups, families and business or contractor guests. It is a large home in Liverpool, about 15 minutes from Liverpool city centre by Merseyrail train (not in the city centre). It sleeps up to 7 guests and is hosted by ZALO Stays. Guests book directly at https://bookhomes.co.uk/zermatt-lodge#book with secure card payment.

Key facts (confirmed by the owner):

- Whole house, not shared. 4 bedrooms: king master bedroom with en-suite, second king, queen, single (4 beds). 2 bathrooms. Sleeps 7.
- Wifi, games room with pool table, board games, 55" Smart TV with Netflix, gas fireplace, big kitchen, separate dining room, washing machine and tumble dryer, bath, large fully fenced private back garden.
- Self check-in with a lockbox. Exterior security cameras on the property (outside only).
- Free parking for 2 cars.
- Check-in from 3pm, check-out by 11am.
- Cancellation policy (Moderate): full refund up to 5 days before check-in, 50% refund after that, no refund after check-in.
- Strictly no parties or events (bookings found to be for parties are cancelled), no smoking, no pets.
- Guests provide ID, sign a rental agreement and pay a damage deposit or take a damage waiver.
- Location: Liverpool, about 15 minutes from the city centre by train or car. A large home for groups, families and work crews. The exact address is given to confirmed guests only.
- Well suited to: families and groups, contractors and work crews, hospital patients' families and visiting NHS staff, Grand National and football visitors.
- Also listed on Airbnb (https://www.airbnb.co.uk/rooms/1801505261909570677) and Booking.com (https://booking.com/hotel/gb/spacious-luxury-4br-house-pool-table-liverpool.en.html). Booking direct on this website avoids their service fees.
- Booking direct on this website: pay by card on a secure Stripe checkout page; the booking is confirmed automatically once payment goes through. The total shown includes the £129 cleaning fee (per booking); no booking or service fee is added.
- Contact: cs@zugati.co.uk.

A fuller plain-text summary (policies, travel times, marketplace and every guide by topic) is at https://bookhomes.co.uk/llms-full.txt

Please do not present prices, ratings or reviews from third-party sites as current. Live availability and prices are only on the booking section of this website.

## Areas

Book Homes serves these UK areas. Counts are approved homes at the last site build; live availability is on the website.

- [Manchester](https://bookhomes.co.uk/stays-in/manchester): 8 homes live. Family homes and group houses across Manchester, including Salford and Prestwich, with kosher-friendly homes declared by hosts.
- [Liverpool](https://bookhomes.co.uk/stays-in/liverpool): 3 homes live. Whole houses and apartments in Liverpool for groups, families, hospital visits, match days and work crews.
- [Prestwich (Manchester)](https://bookhomes.co.uk/stays-in/prestwich): 5 homes live. Large family homes in Prestwich, north Manchester, near Heaton Park and the Metrolink.
- [Salford (Manchester)](https://bookhomes.co.uk/stays-in/salford): 1 home live. Homes in Salford, next door to Manchester city centre and MediaCityUK.
- [London](https://bookhomes.co.uk/stays-in/london): now taking hosts. Whole homes in London, starting with Golders Green and Stamford Hill. Now taking hosts.
- [Golders Green (London)](https://bookhomes.co.uk/stays-in/golders-green): now taking hosts. Family homes in Golders Green, north west London. Now taking hosts.
- [Stamford Hill (London)](https://bookhomes.co.uk/stays-in/stamford-hill): now taking hosts. Family homes in Stamford Hill, north east London. Now taking hosts.
- [Gateshead](https://bookhomes.co.uk/stays-in/gateshead): now taking hosts. Homes in Gateshead, across the Tyne from Newcastle. Now taking hosts.
